title: Rise Up Servants of God, Take Your Stand
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he warns of the spiritual invasion threatening America and encourages believers to rise up and take action through prayer, activism, and a commitment to their faith. He challenges the church to wake up and take responsibility for their region, citing examples of ordinary people making a profound impact through prayer and service. Don't miss this urgent call to action from Pastor Chris, as he rallies the congregation and listeners alike to be part of a movement to reclaim their country for Christ.
